title: Ordering Coffee
summaryZh: 顧客到咖啡店點一杯熱咖啡，跟店員確認牛奶、外帶和付款方式。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi, can I get a small coffee, please?
sentences.zh: 嗨，可以給我一杯小杯咖啡嗎？
sentences.note: can 在句中弱讀成 /kən/，不唸成重音的 /kæn/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sure thing. Do you want hot or iced coffee?
sentences.zh: 沒問題。你要熱的還是冰的？
sentences.note: hot or → /hɑɾɚ/，t 夾在母音之間變閃音，or 弱讀。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hot, please. It's a little cold outside today.
sentences.zh: 熱的，謝謝。今天外面有點冷。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It really is. Do you want milk in that?
sentences.zh: 真的很冷。你要加牛奶嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes, just a little milk and no sugar.
sentences.zh: 要，加一點點牛奶就好，不要糖。
sentences.note: and 弱讀成 /ən/，milk and no 聽起來像 /mɪlkən noʊ/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Got it. Is that for here or to go?
sentences.note: Got it → /ˈɡɑɾɪt/，兩字連讀且 t 變閃音。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: To go, please. I'm walking to work now.
sentences.zh: 外帶，謝謝。我現在正要走路去上班。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: No problem. Do you want anything to eat?
sentences.zh: 沒問題。要不要來點吃的？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: No thanks, just the coffee is fine today.
sentences.zh: 不用了，謝謝，今天只要咖啡就好。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Okay, that's three dollars and fifty cents, please.
sentences.zh: 好的，總共是三塊五毛，謝謝。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Here you go. Can I pay with this card?
sentences.zh: 在這裡。我可以用這張卡付嗎？
sentences.note: Here you go → /hɪɚjəɡoʊ/，you 弱化成 /jə/，三個字連成一串。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Of course. Your coffee is ready right there.
sentences.zh: 當然可以。你的咖啡就在那邊，好了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you so much. Have a good morning!
sentences.zh: 非常謝謝你。祝你早上愉快！

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You too, sir. Come back and see us soon!
sentences.note: Come back and 的 and 弱讀成 /ən/，聽起來像 back'n see。

questions.q: How does he want his coffee?
options: With a little milk and no sugar

questions.q: Why does he want his coffee to go?
options: He is late for a meeting
